in_marathi.name: Bhupinder
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhupinder हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bhupinder is a Sanskrit name derived from two roots – Bhuh (Lord) and Pind (Earth). It translates to 'Lord of the Earth'. This name was given to those rulers who ruled over their lands with just and fair rule.
